name: Andromeda III
tagline: A faint M31 spheroidal member of the swarm — old, metal-poor, dark-matter dominated.
history: Andromeda III is one of the faintest of Andromeda's confirmed satellites — a very low surface-brightness spheroidal resolved into individual stars by deep surveys of M31's halo. It adds a data point to the satellite census that constrains how common such faint companions are around Milky-Way-mass galaxies, a key test of whether the observed counts match cosmological predictions.
